description: Minimum prop names for each hosted Storybook component. The check fails when a component is missing, has no props, loses a listed prop, or reports a docgen error. Pattern, token, and docs entries that match allowlist are skipped. Refresh this file with yarn components-manifest:update after an intentional API change.

allowlist.description: Pattern stories (Marketing Moments, Wallet Home, Backgrounds) are compositions, not design-system components.
Design-token stories document tokens. They are not components in the React or React Native packages.
Docs-only entries such as introduction pages.
